mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC for UNRATE as predictor falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% in the prior month, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% y/y, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as predictor in high inflation regimes falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction (HOUST) exceeds 900.0 thousand units in a 1-month window, it signals a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 900.0 in a month, or Rank IC for HOUST as predictor falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 5.0%), a further decline in unemployment signals tight labor market conditions that may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE as predictor in low unemployment regimes falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases over the prior quarter, or Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
